About Me · David's Music Ministry♪ Low-Cost Ministry

Empowering Gospel Musicians Worldwide with HQ Styles, Tones & Packs

Welcome to David's Music Ministry. I am Karthick David, Music Teacher certified by Trinity College of London, and proprietor for Clef & Melody Music Institute, which provides International Grade certification for students and worship musicians.

Our calling is to run a low-cost ministry, helping gospel musicians and church praise leaders with studio-grade arranger styles, Indian and Western drum loops, Drawbar Hammond B3 organs, and expansion packs for Yamaha, Casio, and Korg keyboards.
